Design review: identity and post reads carry signed profile and media URLs that change on every read, so the review state keeps only identity availability, pull permission, political status, Business Center, post IDs, types and visibility.
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
Post visibility is recorded but not enforced; TikTok decides which post visibilities Spark Ads accept.
Whether each automatic enhancement applies to posts is decided by TikTok; a read-back that drops one is inconclusive.
Ad edits, uploads (Spark Ads Push), authorization-code posts, custom identities, catalog, lead generation and app ads stay unqualified.
No GitHub CLI here and CAMCP is private: CI for the pushed commits was not read from this checkout.
No local Docker; container build/smoke evidence comes from GitHub Actions on the pushed commit.
